from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class PaperReference(BaseModel):
    """A specific citation found in the current document's bibliography."""
    target_paper_title: str = Field(description="The title of the paper being referenced in this document's bibliography")
    citation_marker: Optional[str] = Field(description="Optional citation marker or number, e.g. 'Ref [6]' or '[6]'")
    context_quote: str = Field(description="Short text snippet from the document indicating the reference")

class PaperSummary(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single provided paper."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the paper currently being processed")
    references: list[PaperReference] = Field(description="List of other provided papers cited in this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates extraction results for the processed document."""
    papers: list[PaperSummary]
